The original Gotthard rail tunnel (the historic mountain railway tunnel, not the more recent Gotthard Base Tunnel) was opened in **1882**.

It is approximately **15.04 kilometres (about 15 km)** long. This tunnel was a major engineering achievement of the 19th century and was the world's longest rail tunnel when it opened.
